def _normalize_state_value(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None or value is NO_VALUE:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, Enum):
        return str(value.value)
    return str(value)


def _extract_transition(instance: Any, field_name: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    state = sa.inspect(instance)
    history = state.attrs[field_name].history

    if not history.has_changes():
        return None

    previous = history.deleted[0] if history.deleted else state.committed_state.get(field_name, NO_VALUE)
    current = history.added[0] if history.added else getattr(instance, field_name)

    previous_value = _normalize_state_value(previous)
    current_value = _normalize_state_value(current)

    if previous_value is None or current_value is None or previous_value == current_value:
        return None

    return previous_value, current_value


@event.listens_for(Session, "before_flush")
def enforce_canonical_lifecycle_on_flush(
    session: Session,
    flush_context: Any,
    instances: Any,
) -> None:
    del flush_context, instances

    for instance in session.dirty:
        for model_cls, (field_name, entity_name) in _STATEFUL_MODEL_FIELDS.items():
            if not isinstance(instance, model_cls):
                continue

            transition = _extract_transition(instance, field_name)
            if transition is None:
                break

            previous_value, current_value = transition
            assert_transition_allowed(entity_name, previous_value, current_value)
            break

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Final


class TransitionError(ValueError):
    """Raised when a state transition is not part of the canonical lifecycle."""


_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Final[Mapping[str, frozenset[tuple[str, str]]]] = {
    "document": frozenset(
        {
            ("caricato", "in_elaborazione"),
            ("in_elaborazione", "da_validare"),
            ("in_elaborazione", "eccezione"),
            ("da_validare", "validato"),
        }
    ),
    "document_content": frozenset(
        {
            ("pending", "completed"),
            ("pending", "failed"),
        }
    ),
    "workflow_task": frozenset(
        {
            ("aperto", "assegnato"),
            ("assegnato", "completato"),
            ("aperto", "annullato"),
        }
    ),
    "notification": frozenset(
        {
            ("pending", "sent"),
            ("pending", "failed"),
        }
    ),
    "export_job": frozenset(
        {
            ("requested", "completed"),
            ("requested", "failed"),
        }
    ),
}


def supported_entities() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(sorted(_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS))


def allowed_transitions_for(entity: str) -> frozenset[tuple[str, str]]:
    transitions = _ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.get(entity)
    if transitions is None:
        raise KeyError(f"Unsupported lifecycle entity: {entity}")
    return transitions


def allowed_targets(entity: str, current: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    transitions = allowed_transitions_for(entity)
    return tuple(sorted(target for source, target in transitions if source == current))


def can_transition(entity: str, current: str, target: str) -> bool:
    return (current, target) in allowed_transitions_for(entity)


def assert_transition_allowed(entity: str, current: str, target: str) -> None:
    if not can_transition(entity, current, target):
        allowed_targets_text = ", ".join(allowed_targets(entity, current)) or "<none>"
        raise TransitionError(
            f"Forbidden transition for {entity}: {current!r} -> {target!r}. "
            f"Allowed targets from {current!r}: {allowed_targets_text}"
        )
